title: Spectrum TG32E Electric 4-Wheel Lawnmower 1300W
description_html:
Spectrum TG32E Electric Lawnmower – 1300W

Ideal for small urban, suburban and village gardens, the Spectrum TG32E is a compact, efficient and easy-to-use electric lawnmower that delivers excellent cutting performance with minimal noise and maintenance.

Featuring a practical 32cm cutting width, this stylish mower is packed with features often found on more expensive models, making it an outstanding choice for homeowners seeking quality and value.

The convenient cutting-height adjustment system on each axle allows you to quickly select from three cutting positions ranging from 30mm to 60mm. This unique setup enables the front axle to be set higher than the rear, increasing airflow beneath the deck for improved grass collection performance when conditions demand it.

Powering the TG32E is a robust 1300W brushless induction motor. Designed for reliability and long service life, it delivers strong performance while operating more quietly than conventional motors. As an electric mower, it also produces zero emissions and requires very little maintenance.

Grass collection is handled by a durable 30-litre hard-top collector that is lightweight, easy to remove and simple to empty, helping to make mowing less of a chore.

Designed with user comfort and safety in mind, the TG32E features ergonomically shaped twin control levers and a safety-release switch that stops the blade within seconds when the controls are released.

For added convenience, the upper handle folds down quickly for compact storage and easier transportation.

Large, smooth-rolling wheels provide effortless manoeuvrability across the lawn, while the generous 15-metre power cable offers excellent working reach around smaller gardens.

Please note that this machine requires some assembly before first use. Full instructions are included to guide you through the process, and the assembly is straightforward, requiring only basic tools to complete.
